nativeSourceFacts.fact: Positive PCB rotation uses x*cos+y*sin and y*cos-x*sin; cardinal90=(y,-x),270=(-y,x).
Pad at uses GetFPRelativePosition and absolute GetOrientation, not footprint-relative orientation.
Reads position with SetFPRelativePosition and stored angle with SetOrientation directly.
Shape offset is rotated by absolute pad orientation and added to pad position; electrical anchor remains GetPosition.

method: Headless pinned pcbnew.LoadBoard/GetPosition/GetFPRelativePosition/GetOrientationDegrees/ShapePos queries and SaveBoard/reload on four newly authored isolated fixtures; no TypeScript transform supplies expected values.
